  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the FR-issued card was used from a US IP and CVV failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception applies and no earlier outcome settles the order. No other adverse or Context rule holds. Legitimate foreign-card use with a CVV entry error remains plausible, particularly given prior card use and home delivery, but those facts do not resolve authorization. Recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for id_check. No check has run. Issuer authentication plus identity verification is the cheapest applicable decision-changing check; contact is not required. Decline is not permitted on this evidence. A passed id_check requires clear; failure requires decline."
